item.g:title: The Weight Between Steps - Sketch Series Fine Art Print
item.g:description: A painterly fine art photograph portraying a Native American figure defined by restraint rather than display. Light, stillness, and softened edges shape a moment of inward gravity, where identity and memory are carried quietly rather than declared.
